GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MINISTRY OF HEAVY INDUSTRIES
NOTICE INVITING TENDER

Tender Reference No: MHI/2026/ELEC/0417
Date of Issue: 12 March 2026

1. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

The bidder must be a registered firm with GST registration and PAN number.
Minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 2 crore in the last three financial
years. Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 50,000 shall be furnished along with the
bid. Tender fee of Rs. 1,000 is non-refundable.

2. TERMS AND CONDITIONS

All disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts at New Delhi.
Arbitration shall be governed by the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996.
The successful bidder shall submit an affidavit in the prescribed format.

3. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION

The following items are required for the electrical wiring installation at the
departmental office building:

Item 1: PVC insulated single core unsheathed copper conductor cable, 1.5 sq mm
nominal cross sectional area, suitable for working voltage up to and including
1100 V, for concealed conduit wiring in the office premises. Conductor shall be
annealed electrolytic grade copper.

Item 2: PVC insulated single core copper cable of 2.5 sq mm nominal cross
sectional area for power circuits and socket outlets, 1100 V grade.

Item 3: Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 grade, for the civil works associated with
cable trenching and foundation of the distribution pillar. Minimum 28 day
compressive strength of 43 MPa.

All materials shall bear the ISI mark and shall be supplied conforming to the
relevant Indian Standards in force on the date of supply.

4. DELIVERY SCHEDULE

Delivery within 45 days from the date of the purchase order.

Signature of the Tendering Authority
Seal of the Department
